summary.text: Dan Farrington is the Republican candidate for Oregon House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat David Nelson in a race with no incumbent.
He has run for the Oregon House before, in 2012 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Dan Farrington holds a bachelor's degree from Oregon State University and lists Sunrise Medical Consultants, Inc. as his profession.
He ran for Oregon House District 21 in 2012 and lost to incumbent Brian Clem, a Democrat, who received 59 percent of the vote to Farrington's 37.2 percent.
In 2022 Farrington was the Republican nominee for House District 20, where incumbent Paul Evans won with 54.2 percent of the vote to his 44.1 percent; Libertarian Taylor Rickey received 1.6 percent.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for District 17.
